build_hdemucs_model: build a hybrid Demucs source separation model with configurable STFT, depth, and DConv parameters
create_henc_layer: create an encoder layer for the frequency or time branch with DConv residual and group norm
create_hdec_layer: create a decoder layer with transposed convolution, DConv residual, and skip connection support
run_pad1d: run 1D padding on a tensor with support for reflect mode on small inputs
create_scaled_embedding: create a scaled embedding layer with optional smooth initialization for frequency embeddings
